device: Jetson AGX Xavier 32 GB, JetPack 5.1.8, CUDA 11.4, sm_72
model: Nemotron with Gemma E4B MTP drafts (three proposals), resident service, chat route

protocol.validation_kind: The same-author sets of d1-router-summary.json; prompt wording fixed before this model saw a case
protocol.client: deploy/xavier/pi-evidence-router.mjs over HTTPS, client cache off

accuracy.validation_miss: Request to add a project to the search index routed to workspace search

pi_single_questions.note: Retrieved passages did not hold the answer; the model said so

limitations: Small authored validation set, not independent production accuracy
No option scores: the conservative 0.15 retrieval rule of the d1 router does not apply
Coverage checked on its four development questions only
Routing shares the GPU FIFO; a queued request waits and the client gives up after 5 s
Retrieved excerpt selection and synthesis remain separate quality limitations
